gizmo.title: Scenario scene
gizmo.description: One scene of a branching scenario. Link each choice to another scene with # followed by its scene id.

configure.title: Scene id
configure.description: What choices link to: a link to # followed by this id leads to this scene. Letters, numbers and hyphens.

configure.title: Ending
configure.description: Whether this scene ends a path, and how it turned out.

configure.title: Score
configure.description: Score for reaching this ending. The highest ending score in the scenario is the maximum.
